oliver: Heads-up: Kotlin SDK sample upload test is flaky on API 31 emulator; lots of intermittent 503s and truncated bodies.

sana: Are you using streaming RequestBody or buffered?

oliver: Streaming via a FileInputStream wrapper that reports progress. Works on physical devices but flaky on emulator/CI. Server logs show chunked body cut off and LB returning 503. Client side sees `IOException: unexpected end of stream`.

ben: Common causes: OkHttp automatic retry on non-repeatable bodies, coroutine cancellation races in suspend CallAdapter, or HTTP/2 multiplexing sharing connection state. Which client config?

oliver: Default-ish but with `retryOnConnectionFailure(true)`, `writeTimeout(0)`, and dispatcher defaults. Retrofit uses our suspend adapter.

sana: Try three quick fixes: 1) for streaming endpoints use a client copy with `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)`; 2) set a finite `writeTimeout` like 5m instead of 0; 3) limit per-host concurrency in emulator (maxRequestsPerHost lower).

ben: Also guard suspend adapter continuation to avoid double-resume when cancellation races with callbacks. Example: AtomicBoolean resumed, only resume once; invokeOnCancellation cancels call and sets flag.

oliver: Did a quick test: disabled retries for streaming client and set writeTimeout to 5m and failures dropped by ~80% in my repro.

sana: For SDK parity docs — note that Kotlin coroutine samples encourage high concurrency which surfaces different races than blocking Java examples. Add a sample repeatable RequestBody for <5MB files and a resumable multipart sample for larger files.

ben: CI checklist: teardown clients in tests (shutdown dispatcher executorService and evict connectionPool), use shared dispatcher for many tests, add integration test that does many concurrent cancels to catch leaks.

oliver: Opening PR with docs + sample helper and updated suspend adapter with AtomicBoolean guard. PR will include an emulator checklist and chunked upload recommendations.

ci-bot: CI item created: #7124 — add regression test for streaming uploads.

sana: Thanks — ping if emulator repro persists and we can tcpdump.

oliver: Will do, thanks everyone.
